After graduating from Cornell University with a bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, I began 
my career in the biopharmaceutical industry as a Validation Scientist at Samsung Biologics in South Korea. 

As a validation scientist, I had an opportunity to work on various validation in the biopharmaceutical GMP field, and every part sparked my interest in data analysis. 

I started working on Computerized System Validation, where I became deeply interested in infrastructure of systems and data management in the industry. Then, moving on to working on toxicity data in support of cleaning validation, I became interested in clinical studies. 

Equipment validation that governs the manufacturing control of drug substances sparked a deep interest in the intersection of data science and healthcare. This drive to master quantitative methods for large-scale health data led me to pursue a Master of Science in Biostatistics. 

Below is a brief summary of my experiences. Please refer to [CV](CV_soomin_you.pdf) for more details. 


### Education 

**Master of Science in Biostatistics**, Columbia University, New York, United States of America 

**Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering**, Cornell University, Ithaca, United States of America  


### Research / Projects 

**Research Assistant, at Columbia University Department of Biostatistics:** Working under Dr. Tian Gu to develop risk prediction models using LLM-derived embeddings from wearable accelerometer data. Our manuscript was accepted to the **AMIA 2026 Informatics Summit**. https://github.com/yousmni3269/time_series_llm_evaluation 

**Spatial Transcriptomics in Cancer Biology:** Investigating AI agent integration strategies in tumor tissues in collaboration with MD Anderson Cancer Center.

**Public Health Impact Prize Winner, NYC PRI Hackathon:** Proposed a proactive disease surveillance pipeline using community-level data mining to accelerate outbreak detection.

**Predictive Modeling of Vaccine Response:** Conducted analysis on antibody responses and flu incidence using SVM, boosting, and interpretable machine learning methods (P8106 Data Science II).

**Global Violence Data Pipeline:** Built an end-to-end data pipeline and Shinyapp to analyze worldwide violence trends (P8105 Data Science I). https://projecthyee.github.io/globalviolence/

**Quality Assurance & Validation (Samsung Biologics):** Led the validation lifecycle for mRNA manufacturing facilities and established cleaning limits based on toxicity and TOC recovery to ensure global compliance.
